release_title: TopUp Net Gateway v1.0.11 (Instant Background SMS Forward & 24/7 Keep-Alive)
changelog:
- Instant Background SMS Forwarding: Incoming MFS payment SMS are now dispatched over HTTP immediately inside the broadcast WakeLock window with automatic 3x radio-wakeup retry instead of waiting for deferred background workers.
- Triple-Layer Real-Time Detection: Added dynamic high-priority SMS_RECEIVED receiver, live ContentObserver on content://sms, and a 15-second background watchdog loop inside SmsForegroundService.
- 24/7 Multi-Version Keep-Alive (Android 7 to Android 16+): Migrated to remoteMessaging/specialUse FGS types with onTimeout auto-resurrection, safe Android 12+ AlarmManager fallback, rolling WakeLock renewal, and process startup recovery.
